items.text:
I'll start out by saying that v1.0 feels like it was rushed out with pressure from the publisher. This game is not what I'd call in a finished state, and still feels, and plays like an early access title. I feel the removal of the early access tag is going to disappoint and frustrate people who are expecting a feature complete, polished experience.

This is not a feature complete, polished experience. (Yet) 

With that being said, the developer is still actively pushing fixes and new content, and intends to continue pushing fixes and new content. There's no other game out there that really begins to offer the same experience as Ostranauts, the analog, interactive UI style is brilliant, and the game has a wonderful atmosphere to it that really immerses me.
items.text_zh:
我首先要说，v1.0感觉像是在发行商的压力下仓促推出的。这款游戏不是我所说的完成状态，感觉和玩起来仍然像一款抢先体验作品。我觉得移除抢先体验标签会让那些期待功能完整、打磨精良体验的人感到失望和沮丧。

这不是一次功能完整、打磨精良的体验。（目前还不是）

话虽如此，开发者仍在积极推送修复和新内容，并打算继续推送修复和新内容。市面上没有其他游戏真正开始提供与Ostranauts相同的体验，那种模拟式、互动式UI风格非常出色，而且游戏有一种绝妙的氛围，让我真正沉浸其中。

observations.description: 游戏内容不完整，像抢先体验版
observations.evidence: This game is not what I'd call in a finished state, and still feels, and plays like an early access title.
observations.evidence_zh: 这款游戏不是我所说的完成状态，而且感觉和玩起来仍然像一款抢先体验作品。

items.text:
The mixed reviews make sense, but I'm giving a positive review because i definitely got the moneys worth of the game. (friend bought it for me)

At 100 hours, I feel i've exhausted the most interesting part of the game, and am almost ready to put it down. I'm gonna putter around in the solar system a bit, but the quests and stations are pretty boring and empty so far, the stations are all VERY simple, and the combat and non-combat NPC AI is very bad.  i also hate the emotion system. The emotion system hours of clicking esoteric talking buttons to get a tiny change in your characters emotional needs. Bleh, just fricken console command it away, save your sanity and enjoy the better parts of the game,

The best part of the game is the first part, which takes up 90 hours of that 100 hours at time of review. it's akin to Hardspace shipbreaker, and the dopamine hit is finding rare or good stuff on derelicts and either selling it, or upgrading your ship. I frequently found myself playing the game late thinking "one more derelict, one more."

Not many games give me 100 hours of content for 20 bucks (when not on sale), and even if the devs stop updating it (which they haven't) I'm satisfied.
Here's hoping for either lots of new content expanding ships and parts, as well as better social interactions and NPC intelligence, or a sequel.
items.text_zh:
褒贬不一的评价是有道理的，但我还是给好评，因为我绝对觉得这游戏物有所值。（朋友给我买的）

玩了100个小时，我觉得我已经把这游戏最有趣的部分玩透了，差不多准备放下了。我还会在太阳系里闲逛一会儿，但到目前为止，任务和空间站都相当无聊和空洞，空间站全都非常简单，战斗和非战斗NPC的AI都非常糟糕。我也讨厌情绪系统。情绪系统要你花好几个小时点击那些晦涩难懂的对话按钮，才能让你角色的情绪需求有一丁点变化。呃，干脆用控制台命令把它弄掉算了，省省你的理智，去享受游戏更好的部分吧，

这游戏最好的部分就是开头，在写评测时那100个小时里有90个小时都花在这上面。它类似于《Hardspace: Shipbreaker》，那种多巴胺快感来自于在废弃飞船上找到稀有或好东西，然后要么卖掉，要么升级你的飞船。我经常玩到很晚，心里想着“再搜一艘废弃飞船，再来一艘。”

没多少游戏能花20美元（非打折时）给我100小时的内容，就算开发者停止更新（他们并没有），我也满意了。
希望要么有大量新内容来扩展飞船和部件，以及更好的社交互动和NPC智能，要么出个续作。

items.text:
Game is broken. As a hardcore player of CDDA, I love sandboxes and this had me excited. I feel let down.

All systems it has look great on the surface, but turn out to be shallow husks.


NPCs are the worst. For example, a person can be dying right infront of you and there is no way to interact with them. There are all those traits, all those needs, those dialogue options. But all of them do absolutely nothing.

Every bit of the game from the economy to combat to ships to NPCs to quests feels like it was started and then abandoned half way.

To be honest, I never made it past the "tutorial" area of K-Leg, but I am a guy with a job and the game requires you to build a reactor of randomly appearing rare parts before you can progress further. I spent 3 real-life sessions trying to find the last one and I am just done.
items.text_zh:
游戏是坏的。作为CDDA的硬核玩家，我喜欢沙盒游戏，这款游戏曾让我很兴奋。我感到失望。

它拥有的所有系统表面上看起来都很棒，但结果却是浅薄的空壳。


NPC是最糟糕的。例如，一个人可能就快死在你的面前，而你却无法与他们互动。有那么多特质、那么多需求、那么多对话选项。但所有这些都完全不起作用。

从经济到战斗，从飞船到NPC再到任务，游戏的每一部分都感觉像是开了个头，然后半途而废。

说实话，我从未通过K-Leg的“教程”区域，但我是一个有工作的人，而游戏要求你在继续推进之前，用随机出现的稀有部件建造一个反应堆。我花了三次现实生活中的游戏时段试图找到最后一个部件，我实在受够了。

observations.description: 从经济到战斗到船只到NPC到任务，每个部分都感觉半途而废。
observations.evidence: Every bit of the game from the economy to combat to ships to NPCs to quests feels like it was started and then abandoned half way.

items.text: Game is a solar system wide and an inch thick. It's repetitive and you really have to like the concept of doing something again and again, ideally with a video on the other screen. Nothing is really that challenging except the first time, a lot of features seem half baked, and most people apparently never leave the starting zone. There was a point where I was astonished about how many hours I have because it did not feel like I had that many hours of accomplishment. I managed to escape the starting zone, get a ship to visit other parts of the system, and basically see all the things in the trailer.
items.text_zh: 游戏有一个太阳系那么宽，却只有一英寸厚。它很重复，你真的必须喜欢一遍又一遍做某件事的概念，最好另一块屏幕上还放着视频。除了第一次之外，没有什么真正具有挑战性，很多功能似乎都半生不熟，而且大多数人显然从未离开过起始区域。曾经有一刻，我对自己有这么多小时感到震惊，因为感觉并没有那么多小时的成就感。我设法逃离了起始区域，弄到一艘船去访问星系的其他部分，基本上看到了预告片里的所有东西。

observations.evidence: most people apparently never leave the starting zone
observations.evidence_zh: 大多数人显然从未离开过起始区域

items.text:
This game released from Early Access (EA) into full release with very little content added from the beginning of EA.

There are very few ship parts, very little story, a handful of non-repeating quests, no uniqueness, nothing to explore. What you will see more than anything, is the hard-to-use build menu and the (spaceX) docking port.

In short, once you have finished your first salvage, you've experienced almost everything this game has to offer.

I could say more, but there is no reason to know more about this rather bareboned game, and that makes me sad.

简而言之，一旦你完成了第一次打捞，你就已经体验了这款游戏几乎所有的内容。

我还能说更多，但对于这款相当骨感的游戏，没有理由去了解更多，这让我感到难过。

I like the game enough to recommend, but I also like it enough to wish that there was a bit more to it. Some things still feel fairly placeholder-y. Outside of salvaging and getting to a point of traveling long distance, im not too sure what to spend money or why to progress or what kind of long term goal I should have if any.

items.text:
Before I start, I've been a big fan of Blue Bottle Games, remembering back when I was a kid and playing NeoScavenger. It's a great game, one that I plan to play through and actually beat now that I'm older. I don't think that game can really be improved upon. So, good work! Understand that I'm not coming at this from a malicious angle, I'm just disappointed that you slapped a 1.0 sticker on it despite it not being remotely complete.

Originally I wasn't going to write this review, but after seeing a few other reviews, I think I'll weigh in. Especially since one of the reviewers was banned from the Steam forums for this game, then muted on Discord for trying to discuss the game's issues because he wasn't stating "facts."

[hr][/hr]

[b]Here's the facts, Blue Bottle Games.[/b]

Your game is broken, it's as simple as that. Not broken as in bottom line unplayable, but broken through attrition, these bugs stack together to make the experience unbearable over time.

[b]The EVA Suit Glitch[/b]
One of the bugs I can prove: if your game autosaves the moment your EVA suit breaks, the game still thinks you're wearing it. Put on a new EVA suit, and now the game thinks you're wearing TWO, doubling your slowdown. This bug has apparently existed for years with no fix. I worked around it personally using the givecond console command to force my skill to max so it's more bearable, but the game still tracks it as a skill based penalty, meaning I still suffer a 50% penalty even with a real EVA suit on when heading into the void.

This game is, in no way, in a 1.0 state. I haven't reached the outer planets yet, but from what I understand and have read online, they're just placeholders, copies of stations you've already visited. How is that 1.0?

[b]Crew & Management Issues[/b]
[list]
[*] The management system itself is clunky and poorly implemented.
[*] There's a battery glitch that was stated to be fixed, and was for an hour, but broke again. Once a crewmember swaps a battery, they just drop it on the ground instead of storing it.
[*] Install a treadmill or any workout machine, and crew will use it even while smelly, tired, or needing to handle social needs during downtime. The bigger the crew, the more micromanagement this creates as I don't want all my water gone from random times in which they decide to clean up, and that's IF they decide to clean up. Often, I find myself forcing them to clean themselves so they get less depressed, only to have to do it again because they keep running on that treadmill.
[*] Crew sometimes won't auto do tasks even with the option enabled. Example: I airlock onto a derelict ship to disassemble walls, floors, and conduits. Despite being scheduled, they'll use that STUPID treadmill instead of working. You have to manually assign them, send them out, then re-enable auto task.
[/list]

Yes, I understand the roster system. Yes, they have the right equipment, charged batteries, filled O2 tanks, helmets on. Yes, they're cleared to do everything. This isn't a misunderstanding of the game's mechanics on my part. It's a failure on your part to make crew reliably search for jobs to do.

[b]"Realism"[/b]
[list]
[*] You just launched a bounty system with no convenient or realistic way to subdue or incapacitate NPCs for extended periods. This is especially frustrating since some bounty targets are required alive.
[*] You can put shoes on the wrong feet, with no visual cue for which shoe goes where other than the description. Both shoes visually display as "right" or "left" boots despite not actually being so I'm blanking which direction they face at the moment, but if I remember correctly, they all face left.
[/list]

Very realistic, ty.
But what really bothers me most as a longtime fan is your disregard for people clearly raising issues, like me, and then silencing them. It's a shame, and it's beneath you as a whole.

[hr][/hr]

TL;DR:

Don't get the game, it's been six years into development, people with concerns are being silenced, and it's riddled with bugs that eventually break your game rendering unplayable. 
Also, for some reason, a single save can get as big as a gigabyte, idk why.
items.text_zh:
在我开始之前，我一直是Blue Bottle Games的忠实粉丝，还记得小时候玩NeoScavenger的时光。那是一款很棒的游戏，现在我长大了，打算把它通关并真正打败它。我认为那款游戏真的无法再改进了。所以，干得好！请理解我并不是出于恶意，我只是很失望，尽管游戏远未完成，你们却给它贴上了1.0的标签。

本来我不打算写这篇评测，但在看了其他几篇评测后，我想我也该发表一下意见。尤其是因为其中一位评测者因为试图讨论游戏的问题而被这个游戏的Steam论坛封禁，然后又在Discord上被禁言，理由是他没有陈述“事实”。

[hr][/hr]

[b]以下是事实，Blue Bottle Games。[/b]

你们的游戏是坏的，就这么简单。不是说底线意义上的无法游玩，而是被消耗性地损坏，这些bug叠加在一起，随着时间推移让体验变得无法忍受。

[b]EVA宇航服故障[/b]
我可以证明的一个bug：如果你的游戏在你的EVA宇航服损坏的那一刻自动保存，游戏仍然认为你穿着它。穿上一件新的EVA宇航服，现在游戏认为你穿着两件，让你的减速效果翻倍。这个bug显然已经存在多年，一直没有修复。我个人通过使用givecond控制台命令强制把我的技能调到最高来绕过它，这样稍微好受一些，但游戏仍然将其作为基于技能的惩罚来追踪，这意味着即使穿着真正的EVA宇航服进入虚空时，我仍然承受50%的惩罚。

这款游戏绝无可能处于1.0状态。我还没有到达外行星，但据我了解和在网上读到的内容，它们只是占位符，是你已经访问过的空间站的复制品。这怎么能算1.0？

[b]船员与管理问题[/b]
[list]
[*] 管理系统本身笨拙且实现得很差。
[*] 有一个电池故障，据称已修复，也确实修复了一个小时，但又坏了。一旦船员更换电池，他们就直接把电池扔在地上，而不是存放起来。
[*] 安装一台跑步机或任何健身器材，船员会在休息时间使用它，即使他们身上发臭、疲惫或需要处理社交需求。船员越多，这造成的微观管理就越多，因为我不想因为他们在随机时间决定清理而把水都用光，而且那还是在他们决定清理的情况下。我经常发现自己强迫他们清洁自己以减少抑郁，结果又得再来一次，因为他们一直在那台跑步机上跑步。
[*] 即使启用了选项，船员有时也不会自动执行任务。例如：我通过气闸进入一艘废弃飞船去拆解墙壁、地板和管道。尽管已经排好日程，他们却会使用那台愚蠢的跑步机而不是工作。你必须手动分配他们，把他们送出去，然后重新启用自动任务。
[/list]

是的，我理解花名册系统。是的，他们有合适的装备、充满电的电池、装满的氧气罐、戴着头盔。是的，他们被批准做所有事情。这不是我对游戏机制的误解。这是你们的失败，没能让船员可靠地寻找要做的工作。

[b]“真实感”[/b]
[list]
[*] 你们刚刚推出了一个赏金系统，却没有方便或现实的方法来长时间制服或使NPC失去行动能力。这尤其令人沮丧，因为有些赏金目标需要活捉。
[*] 你可以把鞋子穿错脚，除了描述之外没有任何视觉提示表明哪只鞋该穿哪只脚。两只鞋在视觉上都显示为“右”或“左”靴子，尽管实际上并非如此，我一时想不起来它们朝哪个方向，但如果我记得没错的话，它们都朝左。
[/list]

非常真实，谢谢。
但作为一个长期粉丝，最让我困扰的是你们对像我这样明确提出问题的人的漠视，然后让他们噤声。这是一种耻辱，有失你们整体的身份。

[hr][/hr]

TL;DR：

别买这个游戏，它已经开发了六年，有顾虑的人被噤声，而且它充满了bug，最终会破坏你的游戏，使其无法游玩。
另外，不知为何，单个存档可以大到1GB，我也不知道为什么。
鞋子在视觉上显示为“右”或“左”靴子，尽管实际上并非如此，我一时想不起来它们目前朝向哪个方向，但如果我没记错的话，它们都朝左。
[/list]

非常真实，谢谢。
但作为一个长期粉丝，最让我困扰的是你们对像我这样明确提出问题的玩家的漠视，然后让他们噤声。这很可耻，而且整体而言有失你们的身份。

[hr][/hr]

TL;DR：

items.text:
It feels bad to leave a review like this on a game I've been waiting to leave Early Access for years, and especially because it seemed like it had a good base, even looking at the patch notes I got the idea that it was relatively on a good path.

I loved the first 20 hours. I basically have a flying coffin that I've pimped out a little bit, and I see the trajectory that the game expects from me. I had hope that the early-game serving as a clear tutorial would have a pay-off, when I am approaching the mid-game. However, I visited the closest second "town" (station), and I don't know what I was expecting. But it was definitely more than just like a few paragraphs of atmosphere and then... nothing substantial.

And I fear another 60 hours to get to the end-game would not have a bigger pay-off. I checked the wikies and I am 90% sure that the huge item list that I was impressed by at the beginning is... basically it. Like, there's this illusion that a huge world is out there and many things to explore, but then I feel like that's not actually true.

It may become a good game in about 5 more years if it stays in development, but for now this is still just an early access project. Oh and that's the other thing that bothers me: I feel like I've been lied to with this receiving a 1.0. I'm not bitter, because 20 hours of sheer fun is 20 hours of sheer fun, but I cannot in good conscience recommend this game to anyone else but me.

给一款我多年来一直等待其脱离抢先体验的游戏留下这样的评论感觉很糟糕，尤其是因为它似乎有一个良好的基础，即使看补丁说明，我也觉得它相对走在一条好路上。

我爱最初的20个小时。我基本上有一口飞行棺材，我稍微改装了一下，我看到了游戏期望我走的轨迹。我曾希望早期游戏作为一个清晰的教程会在接近中期游戏时得到回报。然而，我访问了最近的第二个“城镇”（空间站），我不知道我期待什么。但肯定不仅仅是几段氛围文字，然后……没什么实质内容。

我担心再花60个小时到达终局也不会有更大的回报。我查了维基，我90%确定我一开始印象深刻的那份巨大物品清单……基本上就是全部了。就像，有一种幻觉，外面有一个巨大的世界和许多东西可以探索，但我觉得那实际上并不真实。

如果它继续开发，可能再过大约5年它会成为一款好游戏，但就目前而言，这仍然只是一个抢先体验项目。哦，还有另一件困扰我的事：我觉得我被骗了，因为它获得了1.0版本。我并不 bitter，因为20个小时纯粹的乐趣就是20个小时纯粹的乐趣，但我不能凭良心向除我之外的任何人推荐这款游戏。

items.text:
[h1] A heartbreaking waste of potential [/h1]
[b] TLDR Review: [/b] Not worth your money.

This is one of those reviews that hurts to write, truly. At a glance Ostranauts looks like an awesome game, at a glance this game looks like a GOAT in the making, at a glance this game [b] [i] should [/i] [/b] be a blast but it's just not, and sadly it's much worse than it first looks like at first glance.

There are so many issues, ranging from small, to litterally fundamental to the game's conception that I couldn't possibly list them all, so instead I'm going to hammer on the main points that I think need to be addressed. With that said, here goes.

[h2] What is wrong? [/h2]
Like I mentioned, it's a lot, but let me start with the main thing that does this game in for me, the game design itself. Now, that might sound harsh, and yes, it is, however let me explain what I mean, and why I'm so irked by this.

[h3] Pain Point #1 - A false sandbox [/h3]
So here's the first thing, Ostranauts is presented as a kind of hardcore sandbox space sim, a game in which you have to sit down and seriously consider your intentions, weigh your options, and take decisions that affect your life a spacer. Sounds cool, sounds awesome even, sign me up, I want this.

Here's the problem, all of that doesn't matter, at all, let me explain. The problem is that the salvaging gameplay loop that is intended to get you out of debt and onto Venus ends up becoming the only thing really worth doing at all, because once you do end up going to other planets the other options just can't compete, for instance trading has a pretty large buy in and can only really compete if market conditions align well, racing doesn't even scratch the surface, and mining isn't really worth it either. Now, people might want to point out "The Gigs though?", however the problem there is that the more profiatble gigs have an even bigger buy in to be profitable since they require you to build for speed in order to cash in the big bucks. As a result, you effectively become locked into salvaging gameplay for the early game AND the mid-game, with a possibility of making some okay money on an occassional trade when the stars align.

This in turn creates several problems, first is that it means that litterally every single character you make will start the game in the exact same way. Second is that it means that you end up not being able to actually experiment with different ways to play the game until you are well into a save already, at which point you are already optimized for salvaging. The third issue is that those two issues thus effectively push you towards pursuing the end-game content instead, since the mid-game content (mining, trading, racing) just isn't really worth it time/money wise in most cases. Lastly, this also essentially also kills much of they joy with character creation, since the only real skills that matter are hacking, zero-g ops, and eva specialization, in that order, every time.

All of this stemming from 1 bad decision, namely forcing the player to start as a salvager, and not giving them any other options at the start. Consider if instead the player could partake in salvaging, mining, racing, piracy, and anti-piracy early on? All of a sudden your character creation options matter. If you were able to join law enforcement or become a pirate in the early game, then combat skills would matter in the early game. If you were able to begin racing then navigational skills matter. If you were able to begin mining then mining skills matter, so on and so forth. Instead, we're left with this, truth be told, depressingly bad design choice of limiting the player to "the one thing" and nothing else.

This kind of railroad-y design unfortunately permeates the entire game, if you can do something, there's one way of doing it and no more, and most of the things you'd want to be able to do, you just can't even do at all.

[h3] Pain Point #2 - Poorly thought out and implemented systems [/h3]
The next thing that really detracts from the experience is just how disjointed the various gameplay systems are, wether poorly designed, poorly implemented, or both, Ostranauts suffers from a bad case of the player having to "fight the game" to do what they want to do in many cases. For example, if you try to rebuild your ship at a station, the Crew AI will continually walk out of the airlocks without a helmet on while on auto-task, forcing you to save them, wasting your time. At the same time, they'll refuse to do certain tasks and complain about needing EVA helmets [b] when they are already f**king wearing them [/b] and stuff like this is [b] CONSTANT[/b]. For every enjoyable moment in Ostranauts, you will have 9 others that are just frustrating, annoying, or worse.

The Crew AI in general is just a pain to manage, from their overall behaviour, to only really being able to see one crew member's needs at a time, to their behaviour when it comes to zones, to how they consistently walk outside without a helmet, it all just serves to frustrate you instead of invite deeper engagement with the system.

Another thing that "sounds cool on paper, but was implemented poorly" is the interactions system, save for a specific interaction with law enforcement, and getting better hiring prices, friendship and other relationship milestones don't really matter.

[h3] Pain Point #3 - "It doesn't matter" [/h3]
This is probably the main crux of my gripes with this game, very little that you do as a player actually matters, for a game with at first glance seemingly such potential for player driven interaction, emergent gameplay, and meaningful player agency, it has almost none of it. You're railroaded into the salvager > trader/miner/racer > combat progression, and while sure you can stop at any point in that progression, that really just means you don't get any more gameplay. Initially you're driven by a need to repay debt, but that debt will clear pretty quickly once you start salvaging smart and your ship grows so you can salvage in larger quantity too.

Combine that with the fact that most POI's are mostly empty, and with nothing really unique going on, and the issues outlined in #1 & #2 really just end up creating this feeling of apathy towards the world in general, which is sad, because the ship building and piloting is actually pretty cool.

[h3] Pain Point #4 - A sandbox game trying to serve you a story [/h3]
This I think feels more like the Developers salting the wound than anything else. You've got this wonderful setup for a sandbox game, you've got the ship building, you've got the piloting, you've got a moderately interesting character creation system, and then... you build a mostly empty world, railroad the player harder than some story driven games I've played, and make any real build beyond "Hacker with EVA Skills" litterally worthless. And then, the icing on the cake on top of that, they tack on story content that most people don't care about. Like f**k man, you were the supposed to be an emergent story & gameplay type of offering, not yet another linear story space sim.

[h3] Closing thoughts [/h3]
Ultimately, Ostranauts promises big and delivers very little, and as someone who can see the potential of the idea that hurts to see, a lot. One or two good ideas is not enough to make a game, and Ostranauts is a good example of that. Now granted, I don't think that this game beyond saving, but this is not a 1.0 game, and we're probably talking a good two years or so of contuinous work to turn this around.

[h3] Final Verdict - [b] Not worth your money [/b] [/h3]
I hope that sometime in the future, perhaps in a year or two, I can buy this game again, and revisit this review, but until the Devs sit down and have a long, hard talk with themselves, and start making sweeping changes to the gameplay and especially progression structure in favor of player agency, then I cannot in good faith recommend this game to anyone at all, sadly.
items.text_zh:
[h1] 令人心碎地浪费潜力 [/h1]
[b] 简评： [/b] 不值得你花钱。

这是那种写起来很痛的评测，真的。乍一看 Ostranauts 像是一款很棒的游戏，乍一看这款游戏像是正在成形的 GOAT，乍一看这款游戏 [b] [i] 应该 [/i] [/b] 会很好玩，但它就是不好玩，而且遗憾的是，它比乍一看时糟糕得多。

问题太多了，从小问题，到对游戏构想来说简直根本性的问题，我不可能把它们全列出来，所以我要重点敲打我认為需要解决的主要几点。话虽如此，开始吧。

[h2] 哪里出了问题？ [/h2]
就像我提到的，问题很多，但让我从对我来说毁掉这款游戏的主要原因说起，也就是游戏设计本身。现在，这听起来可能很苛刻，是的，确实苛刻，不过让我解释一下我的意思，以及我为什么对此如此恼火。

[h3] 痛点 #1 - 虚假的沙盒 [/h3]
先说第一点，Ostranauts 被呈现为一种硬核沙盒太空模拟游戏，一款你必须坐下来认真考虑自己的意图、权衡选择，并做出影响你作为太空人生活的决定的游戏。听起来很酷，听起来甚至很棒，给我报名，我想要这个。

问题在这里，所有那些都无关紧要，完全无关紧要，让我解释。问题在于，那个本意是让你摆脱债务并前往金星的打捞玩法循环，最终变成了唯一真正值得做的事情，因为一旦你真的去了其他行星，其他选项根本竞争不过，比如贸易的买入成本相当高，只有在市场条件配合得很好时才真正有竞争力，竞速连皮毛都算不上，采矿也不怎么值得。现在，人们可能会想指出“那 Gigs 呢？”，但问题在于，利润更高的 gigs 为了盈利需要更大的投入，因为它们要求你为速度而建造，才能赚到大钱。结果就是，你在前期和中期实际上都被锁死在打捞玩法里，只有在星辰对齐时偶尔做一笔贸易赚点还行的钱。

这反过来又造成了几个问题，第一是这意味着你创建的每一个角色都会以完全相同的方式开始游戏。第二是这意味着你在存档已经进行得很深入之前，实际上无法尝试不同的玩法，而到那时你已经为打捞优化好了。第三个问题是，这两个问题因此实际上把你推向追求终局内容，因为中期内容（采矿、贸易、竞速）在大多数情况下从时间/金钱角度看并不真正值得。最后，这也基本上扼杀了角色创建的大部分乐趣，因为唯一真正重要的技能是黑客、零重力操作和 EVA 专精，按这个顺序，每次都是。

所有这一切都源于 1 个糟糕的决定，也就是强迫玩家以打捞者身份开局，并且一开始不给他们任何其他选择。试想一下，如果玩家一开始就能参与打捞、采矿、竞速、海盗和反海盗呢？突然之间，你的角色创建选项就有意义了。如果你能在前期加入执法部门或成为海盗，那么战斗技能在前期就有意义。如果你能开始竞速，那么导航技能就有意义。如果你 
能够开始采矿，那么采矿技能就重要了，以此类推。相反，我们得到的却是这个，说实话，令人沮丧的糟糕设计选择，把玩家限制在“唯一的一件事”上，别的什么都不行。

这种铁轨式的设计不幸地渗透了整个游戏，如果你能做某件事，那就只有一种做法，没有别的，而大多数你想做的事情，你根本连做都做不了。

[h3] 痛点 #2 - 考虑不周且实现糟糕的系统 [/h3]
下一个真正损害体验的地方，就是各种玩法系统之间有多么脱节，无论是设计糟糕、实现糟糕，还是两者兼有，Ostranauts 都患上了严重的毛病：在很多情况下，玩家为了做自己想做的事，不得不“和游戏对抗”。例如，如果你试图在空间站重建你的飞船，船员 AI 会在自动执行任务时不断不戴头盔走出气闸，逼着你去救他们，浪费你的时间。与此同时，他们会拒绝执行某些任务，并抱怨需要 EVA 头盔，[b]而他们他妈的已经戴着了[/b]，诸如此类的事情[b]层出不穷[/b]。在 Ostranauts 中，每有一个愉快的时刻，就会有另外 9 个只是令人沮丧、恼火，或者更糟的时刻。

总体而言，船员 AI 管理起来就是一件痛苦的事，从他们的整体行为，到一次只能真正看到一个船员的需求，到他们在区域方面的行为，再到他们总是能不戴头盔走到外面，这一切都只会让你感到挫败，而不是邀请你更深入地参与这个系统。

另一件“纸面上听起来很酷，但实现得很糟糕”的东西是互动系统，除了与执法部门的一个特定互动，以及获得更好的雇佣价格之外，友谊和其他关系里程碑其实并不重要。

[h3] 痛点 #3 - “这根本不重要” [/h3]
这可能是我对这款游戏不满的主要症结，作为玩家，你所做的很少真正重要，对于一款乍看之下似乎有如此潜力实现玩家驱动互动、涌现式玩法以及有意义的玩家能动性的游戏来说，它几乎一点都没有。你被强行推入打捞者 > 商人/矿工/赛车手 > 战斗的进程，当然你可以在这一进程中的任何一点停下来，但那实际上只意味着你再也得不到更多玩法了。起初你被偿还债务的需求驱动，但一旦你开始聪明地打捞，那笔债务很快就会还清，而且你的飞船也会成长，于是你也能更大批量地打捞。

再结合大多数兴趣点基本都是空的，而且没有什么真正独特的事情发生，再加上 #1 和 #2 中概述的问题，最终真的只会让人对这个世界产生一种冷漠感，这很可悲，因为飞船建造和驾驶其实相当酷。

[h3] 痛点 #4 - 一款试图给你端上剧情的沙盒游戏 [/h3]
我觉得这更像是开发者在伤口上撒盐，而不是别的什么。你有一个绝佳的沙盒游戏框架，你有飞船建造，你有驾驶，你有一个还算有趣的角色创建系统，然后……你建造了一个基本空无一物的世界，把玩家强行推得比我玩过的一些剧情驱动游戏还厉害，并让任何真正超出“带 EVA 技能的黑客”的构筑都变得毫无价值。然后，在此之上锦上添花的是，他们还硬塞上大多数人根本不在乎的剧情内容。
搞什么鬼啊，老兄，你本该是一款涌现式故事与玩法类型的作品，而不是又一个线性剧情的太空模拟游戏。

[h3] 结语 [/h3]
最终，Ostranauts 承诺了很多，兑现的却极少，而作为一个能看出这个点子潜力的人，看到这一点让我非常痛心，非常痛。一两个好点子不足以做成一款游戏，Ostranauts 就是一个很好的例子。当然，我不认为这款游戏已经无可救药，但这不是一款 1.0 游戏，我们大概需要持续工作两年左右才能扭转局面。

[h3] 最终裁决 - [b] 不值得你花钱 [/b] [/h3]
我希望在未来的某个时候，也许一两年后，我能再次买下这款游戏，并重新审视这篇评测，但在开发者坐下来跟自己进行一场漫长而艰难的谈话，并开始对玩法、尤其是进度结构进行大刀阔斧的改动，以利于玩家自主权之前，我无法凭良心向任何人推荐这款游戏，很遗憾。

items.text:
I bought this game a long time ago because I saw the vision the developer was wanting to build and I wanted to invest in it. I played for the first time since announcing the 1.0 release.

Unfortunately, I can't recommend people get this game if this is what the developers consider a full release. The game is supposed to be a gritty "life simulator" game where you're a poor nobody living in local space who finally gets a chance to escape the drudgery so that you can, finally, start to make a business for yourself. 

The game advertises scavenging derelict ships and finding rare and valuable components--there's no diversity in components. A thruster is a thruster, an antenna is an antenna, etc., there's only one variation of each ship component. 

There are systems in the game that are completely unused. I cannot tell you why I need to have a social life, it doesn't seem to affect anything in the game. Not that it matters because you can't customize your ship into a unique space to call home or anything. 

Combat is terrible. I've found it much easier to exploit a bug and take the CO2 scrubbers from enemy EVA suits. They'll pass out from CO2 poisoning soon enough. 

There doesn't seem to be anything to actually *do* in the game besides repeat the same repetitive docking mini-game, uninstall components, drag them across space (you literally drag them as if you're in gravity). There's no piracy or policing or station/colony development. There's nothing to this sandbox of a game. 

If this is what the devs consider 1.0 then I recommend people keep their money until a lot more content has been released.
items.text_zh:
我很久以前就买了这款游戏，因为我看到了开发者想要构建的愿景，我想投资它。在宣布1.0发布后，我第一次玩了它。

不幸的是，如果这就是开发者认为的完整发布版，我无法推荐人们购买这款游戏。这款游戏本应是一个粗粝的“生活模拟器”游戏，你是一个贫穷的无名小卒，生活在本地空间，终于有机会逃离苦差事，以便最终开始为自己创业。

游戏宣传可以 scavenging 废弃飞船并找到稀有且有价值的组件——组件没有任何多样性。一个推进器就是一个推进器，一个天线就是一个天线，等等，每个飞船组件只有一种变体。

游戏中有一些系统完全未被使用。我无法告诉你为什么我需要有社交生活，它似乎不影响游戏中的任何东西。这倒无所谓，因为你无法将你的飞船定制成一个独特的、可以称之为家的空间或其他什么。

战斗很糟糕。我发现利用一个漏洞，从敌人的EVA服中取走二氧化碳洗涤器要容易得多。他们很快就会因二氧化碳中毒而昏过去。

游戏中似乎除了重复同样的重复性对接小游戏、卸载组件、在太空中拖动它们（你 literally 像在重力中一样拖动它们）之外，实际上没有什么可*做*的。没有海盗行为或警务或空间站/殖民地开发。这个沙盒游戏毫无内容。

如果这就是开发者认为的1.0，那么我建议人们保留他们的钱，直到发布更多内容。

items.text:
Really big shame, I was super excited for this game to be finished but their final release state is just ridiculous. To give the clearest summary possible, typing 'version 1.0' does not actually mean a thing is now 1.0. The game isn't finished, and it almost explicitely tells you that it isn't finished. Most of the map is still placeholder stations, the only fully fleshed out and finished areas seem to be OKLG, Venus, and MAYBE Ceres. If you dock at a station and the text pop-up ends with 'maybe someday pilots will be able to do more than trading,' that is the game telling you 'this is not a finished area.' My question is, if more than half the stations aren't finished, how is this a 1.0 release? How do you go from version 0.15 to 1.0 when you have so much more work to do? Imo, just call 0.15 a 1.0 version and remove the 'early access' tag.

The AI is still bad, they will choke themselves to death in space suits, if they are auto-tasked to haul stuff when their hands are full they will walk to the item and then cancel the task (because they don't know to put down what's in their hand/s,) there's no category for zones separating parts and whole ship pieces ('I want to put electronic parts like motherboards and scrap here, but I have to pick a category that will also cause the crew to haul whole computers and batteries that I don't need.) 

Relating to the above, the person-to-person combat and station security desperately needed more done to it. You can kill an entire station by venting the walls and then just fly off. If security dock with your ship to fine or arrest you 99% of the time you can win the fist fight with them and act like nothing happened. I guess something that would've fixed this is giving the security forces' ships some kind of weaponry, but frankly what REALLY needs to happen is adding more to the personnel combat so there's more challenge to different fights. Security forces having a partner, or adding in armour items, or adding more combat moves, etc. Piracy, or the piracy I've seen, has been some loser on a derelict with brass knuckles popping out and saying 'cough up the goods' before they're ventilated with a pistol. Like, lol, what? I haven't once had difficulty with personnel combat in the game thusfar. Even if there's more to it later on, I do not believe 65 hours is not long enough to see things pick up.
Update: In an area with more pirates, and found an AI issue with the personnel combat. The enemy AI seems to be unaware when they have firearms and will not engage in combat at all. I took out three pirates armed with pistols because instead of fighting back, they repeatedly demanded I surrender while being shot repeatedly. They didn't even try to use melee when I was standing directly infront of them for roughly five minutes. Hostile boarders also don't seem to understand that they're hostile boarders and won't go into my ship to attack me, they just stay in their ship. Also, anyone who isn't hostile who tries to dock with your ship (like if you make an SOS out of fuel call, or when NASS patrols dock for an inspection/issue fines,) they come in too hot, smash the ships together, and end up killing themselves.

Optimization is bad, randomly, for reasons I am completely lost on. The game will enter into a massive slowdown, or refuse to save, or freeze, or take forever to save. When you're on max speed torch driving on a 4 day trip, if you enter these slowdowns the AI can also freeze and cancel their own auto-orders. 

The gameplay loop is fun, but poorly implimented. The game effectively says you're a salvager, this is technically true and technically false. You START as a salvager, but this stops being worth it as you get later into the game. At bare minimum you need to be a space trucker once you get a torch drive, the time investment vs profit of salvage compared to cargo incentivizes cargo. Bounty hunting is in the game, but to do it you need to buy weapons, which are only sold at some stations (which are still placeholders,) and they are far enough away that you won't be able to get there for literal days of playing the game. After 65 hours, I haven't been able to get into ship combat at all. It's an extremely weird thing, when there ARE many systems in the game, but you won't be able to see them for days of irl time and need to go to unfinished parts of the game to get what you need to engage with it.

Personal gripe this time, but I really wish there was more horror/supernatural/strange elements. Someone could argue they're there, but rare, but I'd disagree. There is one major event early on, and once its solved you won't see anything. Atleast, I haven't seen anything else.

I haven't finished the main storyline, but I still have criticisms here regardless. Without spoilers, there has been very little story crossover with the game mechanics. Only the meat storyline affects the game that I've seen. To emphasize, I've played 95 hours total, 65.8 since release, and one storyline actually introduced something that affected how I play. I understand Neo Scavenger also used text screens for its story, but this game isn't played the same way. Combat is not done through text screens, exploration is not done through text screens, conversations are not done through text screens, it's done in a pausible realtime. Maybe there's something that happens later, I've read a dev message that it does, but if you're only seeing something once 65.8 hours in then I'd dare say there is not enough stuff in here. 

Anyway blah blah ramble ramble the game just isn't finished. You can still have fun with it but you should consider that before deciding whether or not to buy it. It came out of early access from a 0.15 (or 0.17? can't remember) version and it shows.
items.text_zh:
真是巨大的遗憾，我超级期待这款游戏完成，但他们的最终发布状态简直荒谬。尽可能给出最清晰的总结：输入“1.0版本”实际上并不意味着某个东西现在是1.0。游戏没有完成，而且它几乎明确地告诉你它没有完成。大部分地图仍然是占位空间站，唯一完全充实和完成的区域似乎是OKLG、金星，也许还有谷神星。如果你停靠在一个空间站，弹出的文本以“也许有一天飞行员能够做的不仅仅是贸易”结尾，那就是游戏在告诉你“这不是一个完成的区域”。我的问题是，如果超过一半的空间站没有完成，这怎么算1.0发布？当你还有那么多工作要做时，你怎么从0.15版本跳到1.0？依我看，干脆把0.15称为1.0版本，然后去掉“抢先体验”标签。

AI仍然很糟糕，他们会穿着宇航服把自己呛死，如果他们手满时被自动分配去搬运东西，他们会走到物品那里然后取消任务（因为他们不知道放下手里的东西），没有区域分类来区分零件和整艘飞船部件（“我想把主板和废料这样的电子零件放在这里，但我必须选择一个类别，这也会导致船员搬运我不需要的整台电脑和电池。”）

与上述相关，人与人之间的战斗和空间站安保迫切需要更多完善。你可以通过给墙壁放气杀死整个空间站，然后直接飞走。如果安保停靠你的飞船来罚款或逮捕你，99%的情况下你可以赢得与他们的拳斗，然后装作什么都没发生。我想能解决这个问题的是给安保部队的飞船配备某种武器，但坦率地说，真正需要发生的是增加更多人员战斗内容，让不同战斗更有挑战性。安保部队有搭档，或者加入护甲物品，或者增加更多战斗动作等等。海盗行为，或者我见过的海盗行为，就是某个废物在废弃飞船上戴着黄铜指虎跳出来说“交出货物”，然后被手枪打得透不过气。就像，哈哈，什么？到目前为止，我在游戏中一次都没有在人员战斗中遇到困难。即使后面还有更多内容，我也不相信65小时还不够看到事情起色。
更新：在一个海盗更多的区域，发现了人员战斗的AI问题。敌方AI似乎不知道他们有枪械，完全不会交战。我干掉了三个持手枪的海盗，因为他们没有反击，而是一再要求我投降，同时被反复射击。当我直接站在他们面前大约五分钟时，他们甚至没有尝试使用近战。敌对登船者似乎也不明白他们是敌对登船者，不会进入我的飞船攻击我，他们只是待在自己的飞船里。另外，任何非敌对的人试图停靠你的飞船（比如你发出燃料求救信号，或者NASS巡逻队停靠进行检查/开罚单），他们进来时太猛，把飞船撞在一起，最终杀死自己。

优化很差，随机地，原因我完全不明白。游戏会进入大规模减速，或者拒绝保存，或者冻结，或者保存要花很长时间。当你在4天旅程中以最大速度火炬驱动时，如果你进入这些减速，AI也可能冻结并取消他们自己的自动命令。

游戏循环很有趣，但实现得很差。游戏实际上说你是打捞者，这在技术上是对的，也在技术上是错的。你开始时是打捞者，但随着游戏后期进展，这不再值得。至少一旦你获得火炬驱动，你需要成为太空卡车司机，打捞与货物相比的时间投入与利润激励了货物。赏金猎人在游戏中，但要做它你需要购买武器，这些武器只在某些空间站出售（这些仍然是占位符），而且它们足够远，你实际上玩几天游戏都到不了那里。65小时后，我完全没能进入飞船战斗。这是一件极其奇怪的事情，当游戏中有许多系统时，但你现实时间几天都看不到它们，并且需要去游戏未完成的部分获取参与所需的东西。

这次是个人抱怨，但我真的希望有更多恐怖/超自然/奇怪元素。有人可能会说它们存在，但很罕见，但我不同意。早期有一个重大事件，一旦解决你就不会再看到任何东西。至少，我没有看到其他任何东西。

我还没有完成主线剧情，但无论如何我在这里仍有批评。没有剧透，故事与游戏机制的交叉非常少。我只看到肉类 storyline 影响游戏。强调一下，我总共玩了95小时，发布后65.8小时，只有一个 storyline 实际引入了影响我游玩方式的东西。我理解Neo Scavenger也用文本屏幕讲故事，但这款游戏的玩法不同。战斗不是通过文本屏幕完成的，探索不是通过文本屏幕完成的，对话不是通过文本屏幕完成的，它是在可暂停的实时中完成的。也许后面会发生什么，我读过开发者消息说会，但如果你在65.8小时后才只看到一次东西，那我敢说这里内容不够。

总之 blah blah 胡扯胡扯，游戏就是没完成。你仍然可以玩得开心，但在决定是否购买之前应该考虑这一点。它从0.15（还是0.17？记不清了）版本脱离抢先体验，而且这很明显。

items.text:
[h1]6/10 - отличная основа, но контента быстро перестаёт хватать[/h1]

[b]64 часа после релиза 1.0.[/b]

[h2]Плюсы[/h2]

[b]+[/b] Очень интересное начало: постепенно разбираешься в корабле, атмосфере, энергии и вообще понимаешь, как тут выживать.

[b]+[/b] Классная система управления кораблём через консоль и навигацию. Полёты реально ощущаются как полёты.

[b]+[/b] Разбирать дереликты — одно из самых интересных занятий в игре.

[h2]Минусы[/h2]

[b]Однообразие.[/b] Улетел на другой конец Солнечной системы — а там практически та же игра. Те же предметы, корабли, технологии и занятия. Нового прогресса почти нет.

[b]− Интерфейс.[/b] Очень часто приходится догадываться, что делает та или иная кнопка. Например, я купил корабль через [b]Брокера[/b], а после покупки обнаружил, что он находится [b]в 276 млн км от меня[/b]. До покупки игра практически не объяснила, что я приобретаю корабль, который физически находится фиг знает где.

[b]− Баги.[/b] Особенно задолбала самопроизвольная пауза на K-Leg: уведомления отключены, автопауза отключена, но игра всё равно периодически ставит игру на паузу сама. Трам на Китайской станции вообще не работает.

[b]− Подработки и NPC быстро становятся скучными.[/b] Большинство заданий — «принеси X» или «поговори за меня». Очень не хватает нормальных цепочек заданий и событий.

[b]− Сюжетные крючки не всегда имеют отдачу.[/b] Например, я сам поставил себе целью найти родителей персонажа и ради этого полетел через станции. В итоге добрался до мамы — и практически ничего интересного не произошло.

[h2]Итог[/h2]

[b]6/10.[/b]

Атмосфера и основа игры отличные, первые десятки часов реально затягивают. Но потом понимаешь, что [b]огромный мир пока наполнен слишком однообразным контентом[/b].

Потенциал у игры огромный, через годик может моддеры и разрабы игру допилят. Игру рекомендую сейчас, пока цена адекватная. Свои 50 часов вы получите кайфа а потом вам надоест.
items.text_zh:
[h1]6/10 - 出色的基础，但内容很快就变得不够用[/h1]

[b]1.0发布后64小时。[/b]

[h2]优点[/h2]

[b]+[/b] 非常有趣的开局：你会逐渐搞懂飞船、大气、能量，并总体上明白如何在这里生存。

[b]+[/b] 通过控制台和导航来操控飞船的系统很棒。飞行真的感觉像在飞行。

[b]+[/b] 拆解废弃飞船是游戏里最有趣的活动之一。

[h2]缺点[/h2]

[b]单调。[/b] 飞到太阳系的另一端——那里几乎是同样的游戏。同样的物品、飞船、科技和活动。几乎没有新的进展。

[b]− 界面。[/b] 经常得靠猜某个按钮是干什么的。比如，我通过[b]经纪人[/b]买了一艘飞船，买完之后才发现它[b]离我有2.76亿公里[/b]。购买之前，游戏几乎没有解释我买的是一艘物理上位于鬼知道哪里的飞船。

[b]− Bug。[/b] 尤其烦人的是K-Leg上的自动暂停：通知关了，自动暂停也关了，但游戏还是会时不时自己把游戏暂停。中国空间站上的电车根本不工作。

[b]− 兼职和NPC很快就变得无聊。[/b] 大多数任务都是“把X带来”或“替我说话”。非常缺少像样的任务链和事件。

[b]− 剧情钩子并不总是有回报。[/b] 比如，我自己把找到角色父母设为目标，为此穿过一个个空间站。结果找到了妈妈——却几乎没发生什么有趣的事。

[h2]总结[/h2]

[b]6/10。[/b]

氛围和游戏基础都很出色，最初几十小时确实很吸引人。但之后你会明白，[b]这个庞大的世界目前填充的内容还是太单调了[/b]。

这游戏的潜力巨大，也许一年后模组作者和开发者会把它打磨好。现在价格还算合理，我推荐这款游戏。你能获得大约50小时的乐趣，然后就会腻了。

items.text:
Fun for a bit but the more you play the more it's clear this isn't close to finished. this was quite clearly kicked out of early access by factors external to game development.  aka the publisher, financial reasons or the dev maybe being sick of it??

i'd call it maybe 50% done.

i spent far too much time at the starting station and now that i've gone out and explored the system it's like an empty mall

there's basically 3 functional locations and a dozen more that are empty apart from a few basic NPC's and standard services. 
CQB combat and social gameplay are virtually identical and feel completely unimplemented. they're basically press button to be friendly / not so friendly. for example flirting consists of making a single weird facial expression over and over and over and over again. and you experience that in a scrolling text field.

Crew management is like the sims with terrible AI. it's just obnoxious. when i restarted a fresh save i just didn't bother getting any more crew than the player character.

What is fun and implemented well:

- Ship navigation (RCS or torch drive) it really feels like you're steering a brick through space or a brick tied to a nuclear reactor that's throwing fusion exhaust out of the bottom.
- Ship to ship combat.  caveat: it's basically isolated to 1 location unless you go full murderhobo

What's okay

- Constructing your ship.  it works but oh dear lord is it tedious to design and modify your brick
- Mining.   it's functional and somewhat tied in with ship combat (it's a contested zone).  but not particularly amazing. it's fine.

what's bad:

- Crew control.  Half the time the autotask stops working for some inexplicable reason and you have to take care of every persons needs the sims style.  literally half of the needs are convoluted and annoying to deal with (the social needs) where 1 is almost impossible to satisfy (altruism) 
- 80% of the solarsystem is bland empty stations with nothing special to do.
- Social / CBQ combat.  it's spamming the same things over and over to achieve the desired result with little in the way of useful feedback.
- The performance is atrocious.  loading takes ages, saving takes ages, the autotask function stutters the game constantly if you make your character build something as simple as a 10x10 floor
- There's 0 quality of life.    that 10x10 floor?   you'd better have manually filled some backpacks with flooring cause otherwise your character will grab them 1 by 1 by 1.  i'm just glad there's a mod that helps with picking up 100 pieces of floor first. cause the alternative is that you basically do that manually!
items.text_zh:
玩一会儿挺有趣，但你玩得越多就越清楚这离完成还差得远。这很明显是被游戏开发之外的因素踢出了抢先体验。也就是发行商、财务原因，或者开发者可能自己都玩腻了？？

我会说它大概完成了50%。

我在起始空间站花了太多时间，而现在我出去探索了这个星系，它就像一座空荡荡的商场

基本上只有3个有功能的地点，还有十几个除了几个基础NPC和标准服务之外空空如也的地方。
室内近战和社交玩法几乎一模一样，感觉完全没有实装。它们基本上就是按按钮来表示友好/不那么友好。比如调情就是一遍又一遍又一遍又一遍地做一个奇怪的面部表情。而你是在一个滚动文本框里体验这些的。

船员管理就像AI糟糕透顶的《模拟人生》。就是很烦人。当我重开一个新存档时，我干脆懒得招募任何超出玩家角色之外的船员。

好玩且实现得不错的部分：

- 飞船导航（RCS或火炬驱动）真的感觉像是在太空中驾驶一块砖头，或者一块绑在核反应堆上、从底部喷出聚变尾焰的砖头。
- 舰对舰战斗。但有个前提：除非你彻底化身杀人狂，否则它基本上只局限于1个地点

还行的部分

- 建造你的飞船。它能用，但天哪，设计和修改你这块砖头真是太繁琐了
- 采矿。它能用，而且某种程度上和舰船战斗挂钩（那是个争夺区）。但并不是特别惊艳。还行吧。

糟糕的部分：

- 船员控制。有一半时间自动任务会因为某些莫名其妙的原因停止工作，你就得像《模拟人生》那样照顾每个人的需求。字面上一半的需求都复杂又烦人（社交需求），其中1个几乎不可能满足（利他主义）
- 太阳系的80%都是平淡空洞的空间站，没什么特别可做的。
- 社交/室内近战。就是一遍又一遍地重复同样的事情来达到想要的结果，几乎没有什么有用的反馈。
- 性能糟糕透顶。加载要花很久，保存要花很久，如果你让你的角色建造一个简单到只有10x10的地板，自动任务功能就会让游戏不断卡顿
- 生活质量改进为0。那个10x10的地板？你最好已经手动往几个背包里装好了地板材料，否则你的角色会一块一块一块地拿。我真庆幸有个mod能帮忙先捡起100块地板。因为替代方案基本上就是你得手动去做！

observations.description: 大部分星系是空洞无内容的站点
observations.evidence: 80% of the solarsystem is bland empty stations with nothing special to do.
observations.evidence_zh: 80%的太阳系都是平淡无奇的空荡空间站，没什么特别的事可做。

items.text:
TLDR: Calling this a 1.0 release is like pointing at a cow and calling it a steak. 

Ostranauts would be my absolute dream game......  if it was actually finished.
I deeply love the idea here, thats why i played it for so long....  But oh man, i had to fight the game at every turn for my fun. 

Rarely have i ever seen a game that is soo buggy, soo glitchy, soo poorly optimized, so critically falwed in many of its systems and controlls.... and yet so engaging(over 100 hours speak for themselves).

All of this would be(and for someone with my tastes veary much is) fine...... for an early acess game... for an alpha. But calling whats on offer here 1.0 is a crime and deeply dissapointing. Especially because the game clearly is someones passion project and anything but a cashgrab.. 

Dont, under no circumstances buy this, unless you are willing to play a broken alpha that (considering the full release) will likely never get adequately finished or even fixed.




Here a List of issues i encountered, this list is by no means exhaustive....  

Buggy Npcs: (i looted soo many EVA suits from random pedestrians walking out the airlock without a helmet)

Buggy Task system: (every tasks is performed 1 by one, from bottom screen to top screen with no regard to distance or required items, my character must easily get in 30000 steps a day in the small cramped ship)

Buggy Life support: compressing gas from a room into a can and than releasing it again magically cools it to -273°C for some reason which in turn reduces its pressure.. making it increadibly hard for heaters to heat it up again...

Missing automation: there is a "signal box" item in the game that even teases us with settings for logical functions... hovever it cant recieve inputs from any other device, so in effect its just a needlessly complicated powerswitch. 

Missing device functionality in general (you cant even customize the "to hot/To cold" threshholds at the thermostat)

Insufficient controll settings in general: not being able to selectively set power levels for directional and rotational thrust is fine in the beginning when everything is super slow, but man does it suck when you pilot your 50 ton custom freighter through the venusian atmosphere and the shortest of cklicks for a tiny course correction sends you spinning to your death becaus you did not revert to 1x speed on your flight that takes 5 real time minutes even on 16x speed. 

Lack of systems variety... the only system that has a direct upgraded version (besides the diffrently sized batteries and the turbo pumps) is the kang rcs intake wich is surpassed by the pricier/rarer hydra. There is 0 variety in regards to thrusters, reactor parts, nav consoles, beds, sensors, tanks..   no upgrades, no sidegrades....  just more of the same old boring stuff. 

Orbital mechanics ar major BS: How come, that when i fly right up to the venusian orbital station and i perfectly align my orbit to it (with the provided match speed setting) it rapidly acellerates away from me the moment i disable the setting? we share the exact same orbit, it should at best drift very slowly towards or away from me. Does it not like me? does it use its thrusters to boost away from me?  

Also, if you want us to engage with orbital mechanics, at least give us a propper maneuver palnner Kerbal space programm came out 11 years ago ffs.
items.text_zh:
TLDR：把这称为1.0正式版，就像指着一头牛说它是牛排。

Ostranauts本会是我绝对的梦想游戏……如果它真的完成了的话。
我深深喜爱这里的构想，这就是为什么我玩了这么久……但天哪，我为了获得乐趣，不得不时时刻刻跟这游戏搏斗。

我很少见到一款游戏如此充满bug、如此故障频出、优化如此糟糕、许多系统和操控存在如此关键的缺陷……却又如此引人入胜（超过100小时本身就说明问题）。

所有这些本来会（而且对于像我这种口味的人来说确实非常）没问题……对于一款抢先体验游戏……对于一款alpha版来说。但把这里提供的东西称为1.0版是一种犯罪，而且令人深感失望。尤其是因为这款游戏显然是某人的热情项目，绝不是圈钱之作。

不要，在任何情况下都不要买这个，除非你愿意玩一个破碎的alpha版，而且（考虑到正式发行）它很可能永远得不到充分的完成，甚至修复。




以下是我遇到的一堆问题，这份清单绝非详尽无遗……

有bug的NPC：（我从随机行人那里捡了太多EVA服，他们不戴头盔就走出了气闸）

有bug的任务系统：（每个任务都一个接一个地执行，从屏幕底部到屏幕顶部，完全不考虑距离或所需物品，我的角色在这艘狭小拥挤的飞船里每天轻松走30000步）

有bug的生命维持系统：把房间里的气体压缩进罐子，然后再释放出来，不知为何会神奇地冷却到-273°C，这反过来又降低了它的压力……让加热器极难把它重新加热……

缺失的自动化：游戏里有一个“信号盒”物品，甚至用逻辑功能设置来挑逗我们……然而它无法接收任何其他设备的输入，所以实际上它只是一个没必要地复杂的电源开关。

总体上缺失的设备功能（你甚至无法在恒温器上自定义“太热/太冷”的阈值）

总体上不足的控制设置：在一切超级缓慢的开局阶段，无法为方向推进和旋转推进选择性地设置功率级别还算可以，但天哪，当你驾驶50吨的定制货船穿过金星大气层时，为了微小的航向修正而进行的最短点击都会让你旋转着送命，因为你在一次即使16倍速也要花5分钟真实时间的飞行中没有切回1倍速。

缺乏系统多样性……唯一有直接升级版本的系统（除了不同尺寸的电池和涡轮泵）是kang RCS进气口，它被更贵/更稀有的hydra超越。在推进器、反应堆部件、导航控制台、床、传感器、储罐方面有0多样性……没有升级，没有横向替换……只是更多同样无聊的老东西。

轨道力学完全是胡扯：为什么当我飞到金星轨道站正旁边，并（用提供的匹配速度设置）完美地将我的轨道与它对齐时，我一禁用该设置，它就迅速加速远离我？我们共享完全相同的轨道，它最多应该非常缓慢地朝我漂来或漂离。它不喜欢我吗？它用推进器加速远离我吗？

另外，如果你想让我们接触轨道力学，至少给我们一个像样的机动规划器，Kerbal太空计划11年前就出了，靠。

observations.description: 系统种类缺乏，推进器、反应堆部件、导航控制台等没有升级或变体
observations.evidence: Lack of systems variety... the only system that has a direct upgraded version (besides the diffrently sized batteries and the turbo pumps) is the kang rcs intake wich is surpassed by the pricier/rarer hydra. There is 0 variety in regards to thrusters, reactor parts, nav consoles, beds, sensors, tanks..   no upgrades, no sidegrades....  just more of the same old boring stuff.
observations.evidence_zh: 缺乏系统多样性……唯一有直接升级版本的系统（除了不同尺寸的电池和涡轮泵之外）就是kang RCS进气口，而它又被更贵/更稀有的hydra所超越。在推进器、反应堆部件、导航控制台、床、传感器、储罐方面有0多样性……没有升级，没有横向替换……只是更多同样老套无聊的东西。

items.text:
Many people compare this game to SS13.
This comparison is actually why I'm giving it a negative review, because even in my brief period of play I can see a lot of issues this game has that SS13 doesn't, not to mention having less content than a free multiplayer game like SS13. The comparison is actually incredibly unfavorable for this game.
If this game were in-dev I'd hold off on this rating but 1.0 hasn't made it any more fun to play than the development version.
I regret buying this game. I advise you not to make the same mistake.
items.text_zh:
很多人把这款游戏比作SS13。
这个比较实际上正是我给出差评的原因，因为即使在我短暂的游玩期间，我也能看出这款游戏有很多SS13没有的问题，更不用说内容比SS13这样的免费多人游戏还少。这个比较实际上对这款游戏极其不利。
如果这款游戏还在开发中，我会暂缓评分，但1.0版本并没有让它比开发版本更好玩。
我后悔买了这款游戏。我建议你不要犯同样的错误。

observations.description: 游戏内容比免费的SS13还少。
observations.evidence: having less content than a free multiplayer game like SS13
observations.evidence_zh: 内容比SS13这样的免费多人游戏还少

items.text:
No, its not worth your time. When you need a mod so AI can pick up stacks of parts for repairs and they can't grab everything they need to repair or build something at once that is a waste of your real life time.

Even after that the rest of the world feels empty-- maybe empty is not the right word but dull.

If you do play the game don't spend a year "saving money" during character creation, as soon the game starts you can do gig's that are simple give item X to Y on the station and make more money then your PC did during a year of saving.
items.text_zh:
不，它不值得你花时间。当你需要一个mod才能让AI捡起成堆的零件进行维修，而且它们无法一次性抓取修理或建造某样东西所需的所有东西时，那就是在浪费你的现实生活时间。

即使在那之后，世界其余部分也感觉空洞——也许空洞不是正确的词，而是乏味。

如果你真的玩这个游戏，不要在角色创建期间花一年时间“省钱”，因为游戏一开始你就可以做那些简单的任务，比如在空间站上把物品X交给Y，赚的钱比你PC省一年钱还多。

observations.description: 世界感觉空虚或沉闷
observations.evidence: the rest of the world feels empty-- maybe empty is not the right word but dull.
observations.evidence_zh: 除此之外，世界其余部分感觉空洞——也许空洞不是合适的词，但就是乏味。

items.text: I think this game can go the distance. I think the key problem at the moment are load times. Beyond that 1.0 is very much so a vertical slice and could use more content breadth. That being said with the vertical slice complete it should be adding more to existing systems, rather than creating the systems so I'm hopeful.
items.text_zh: 我认为这游戏能走得很远。我认为目前的关键问题是加载时间。除此之外，1.0 很大程度上只是一个垂直切片，需要更多内容广度。话虽如此，既然垂直切片已经完成，它应该是在现有系统上添加更多内容，而不是创建系统，所以我抱有希望。

observations.evidence: 1.0 is very much so a vertical slice and could use more content breadth
observations.evidence_zh: 1.0版本非常像是一个垂直切片，并且可以需要更广泛的内容。

items.text:
[h1]Ostranauts - świetny szkielet, który wciąż czeka na właściwą grę[/h1]

Gra kusi obietnicami wysokiego poziomu symulacji i ciekawymi metodami budowania statków kosmicznych. Ale czy tych obietnic dotrzymuje?

[b]Poniekąd tak.[/b]

Można spędzić wiele godzin na szukaniu wartych splądrowania wraków, sprzedawaniu komponentów, byle tylko starczyło na hipotekę, a kiedy ma się już trochę pieniędzy - na ulepszaniu swojego okrętu. Tworzymy wtedy jakiś nieboży amalgamat posklejany z dziesiątek innych statków.

Po drodze robimy małe śledztwa detektywistyczne, aż w końcu dochodzimy do momentu, w którym możemy flipować gruzy z dużym zyskiem. A jeśli dobrze się postaramy, znajdzie się nawet miejsce na własny reaktor fuzyjny.

I trzeba przyznać - [b]samo robienie tego jest całkiem ciekawe.[/b]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Problem zaczyna się wtedy, kiedy już zrobimy to, co mieliśmy zrobić[/h2]

[b]Po co?[/b]

I to jest największa bolączka, jaką mam z tą grą. [i]Ostranauts[/i] to po prostu bardzo dobry szkielet symulacji kosmicznej, ale mam wrażenie, że na tym szkielecie wciąż brakuje właściwej gry.

Postawiłeś reaktor i odblokowałeś podróż międzyplanetarną? Spoko. Tylko po co właściwie wybierać się na inne planety? Podróż trwa kupę czasu, nie wiesz, co tam zastaniesz, musisz wcześniej przygotować odpowiednie kwatery i zapasy, a ostatecznie raczej nie czeka tam na ciebie nic przełomowego.

Interakcje społeczne są dość kiepskie. Jeśli chcesz, żeby ktoś został twoim przyjacielem, to w zasadzie wystarczy wystarczająco długo z nim gadać. A kiedy już jesteście przyjaciółmi - co dalej? Nic specjalnego. Może trochę łatwiej da się go zwerbować czy coś, ale o załodze jeszcze za chwilę.

Ulepszyłeś statek, masz fajne silniki i sporo paliwa, więc możesz podróżować dalej. Tylko co z tego? Nie spotykasz lepszych wraków ani szczególnie ciekawych przeszkód.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Piraci i konsekwencje (a raczej ich brak)[/h2]

Czasami na wraku można spotkać pirata. Swoją drogą, pirat siedzący zupełnie sam na wraku, bez zadokowanego własnego statku, rodzi pytanie:

[b]Co on tam w ogóle robi?[/b]

Takiego pirata można bez większych problemów rozwalić. Ale załóżmy, że nasza postać nie jest maszyną do zabijania i chcemy go oszczędzić. Nokautujesz go i zabierasz na swój statek. Po chwili delikwent wstaje i mimo że jest bezbronny, rzuca się na ciebie i każe oddawać fanty.

Więc jaka jest opcja na rozprawienie się z piratami?

[b]Wystrzelenie ich w otchłań kosmosu.[/b]

Nasza postać oczywiście w żaden sposób nie przeżywa traumy związanej z odebraniem komuś życia.

Można również werbować załogę, ale wydawanie rozkazów jednej postaci było już wystarczająco toporne, a większa załoga jest bardzo kosztowna - zarówno jeśli chodzi o pieniądze w grze, jak i o twój komputer.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Performance[/h2]

[b]Jasny gwint.[/b]

Czy ta gra działa na jednym wątku, czy o co tutaj chodzi?

Załóżmy, że dokujesz do średniej wielkości wraku. Najpierw wydajesz rozkaz, żeby twój ludzik zdemontował 20 ścian i podłóg. Odpalasz prędkość x16. Czasem chrupnie, ale jakoś to idzie.

Potem wydajesz rozkaz, żeby utworzyć nowe pomieszczenie na swoim statku. Rozkładasz siatkę podłogi i dookoła stawiasz ściany.

[b]I jest koniec.[/b]

Nie wiem, czy logika dostarczania przedmiotów sprawdza każdą kratkę twojego statku i wraku, ale ściny są momentami nierealne. Jeśli chcesz postawić 20 podłóg, wygląda to tak, jakby wszystkie kratki były sprawdzane 20 razy, a kiedy gra już wszystko przemieli, nagle jest OK.

A mówimy tutaj o pomieszczeniu 4×5. Co się stanie, jeśli ktoś będzie chciał zbudować pomieszczenie 20×10?

Do tego dochodzą długie loadingi i głupie AI. Potrzebujesz pięciu takich samych przedmiotów? Zamiast podnieść cały stack pięciu, postać woli zrobić pięć osobnych wycieczek.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Świat[/h2]

Niestety świat jest również bardzo pusty i sprawia wrażenie makiety.

Na stacji kosmicznej zawsze jesteś jedynym zadokowanym statkiem. Nigdy nie zobaczysz NPC-a, który przyleci, zadokuje albo odleci. Jeśli podlecisz do wraku, do którego NPC już zadokował, to ten NPC faktycznie tam będzie - ale nic nie robi.

Możesz więc po prostu ograbić wrak, a on nawet nie zwróci na ciebie uwagi.

Jeszcze lepiej jest, kiedy przylecisz do miejscówki piratów i wymontujesz istotny dla tamtejszego reaktora komponent. Nikt nie zareaguje. Możesz po prostu zabrać go na swój statek i odlecieć.

To wszystko sprawia, że świat wygląda bardziej jak zbiór scenariuszy przygotowanych specjalnie dla gracza niż żywe miejsce, w którym faktycznie coś się dzieje.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]I mimo wszystko… polecam[/h2]

[i]Ostranauts[/i] ma [b]bardzo dużo niedociągnięć[/b]. I mimo całej tej krytyki [b]polecam grę[/b].

Nie widziałem jeszcze całej zawartości gry - nie dotarłem do eksploracji planet, asteroid miningu ani części endgame'u, więc nie będę udawał, że oceniam całość.

Przez [b]41 godzin[/b], które w niej spędziłem, byłem naprawdę pochłonięty. Jest tutaj sporo rzeczy do robienia, a samo budowanie, ulepszanie i kombinowanie ze statkiem potrafi dać mnóstwo satysfakcji.

Uważam jednak, że obecny poziom ukończenia wskazuje bardziej na [b]bardzo dobry Early Access niż na finalny produkt[/b].

Dałbym tej grze jeszcze rok albo dwa rozwoju. Będę śledził newsy i czekał na duży update.

[b]Na ten moment: polecam, ale z zastrzeżeniami.[/b]
items.text_zh:
[h1]Ostranauts——一副出色的骨架，却仍在等待真正的游戏[/h1]

游戏以高度模拟和有趣的太空飞船建造方式为诱饵。但它真的兑现了这些承诺吗？

[b]某种程度上是的。[/b]

你可以花很多小时寻找值得搜刮的残骸、出售部件，只为凑够抵押贷款，而当你已经有点钱时——就用来升级自己的飞船。这时我们会造出一个由数十艘其他飞船拼凑而成的不伦不类的混合体。

一路上我们会做些小小的侦探调查，直到最终到达可以高利润倒卖废墟的阶段。如果我们足够努力，甚至还能给自己的聚变反应堆找到一席之地。

而且必须承认——[b]做这件事本身相当有趣。[/b]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]问题始于我们做完本该做的事之后[/h2]

[b]为了什么？[/b]

这就是我对这款游戏最大的痛点。[i]Ostranauts[/i]只是一个非常好的太空模拟骨架，但我感觉这个骨架上仍然缺少真正的游戏。

你装好了反应堆，解锁了行星际旅行？不错。但究竟为什么要去其他行星？旅程要花很长时间，你不知道那里会遇到什么，必须提前准备好合适的舱室和补给，而最终那里大概也不会有什么突破性的东西等着你。

社交互动相当糟糕。如果你想让某人成为你的朋友，基本上只要跟他聊得足够久就行。而当你们已经是朋友之后——然后呢？没什么特别的。也许招募他会稍微容易一点之类的，但关于船员的事待会儿再说。

你升级了飞船，有了不错的引擎和大量燃料，所以你可以航行得更远。可那又怎样？你不会遇到更好的残骸，也不会遇到特别有趣的障碍。

[hr][/hr]

[h2]海盗与后果（或者说根本没有后果）[/h2]

有时在残骸上会遇到海盗。顺带一提，一个海盗孤零零地坐在残骸上，没有自己的飞船停靠在那里，这引出一个问题：

[b]他到底在那儿干什么？[/b]

这样的海盗可以毫无困难地干掉。但假设我们的角色不是杀人机器，我们想饶他一命。你把他打晕并带回自己的飞船。过了一会儿，这家伙站起来，尽管手无寸铁，却扑向你，要你交出财物。

那么对付海盗的选项是什么？

[b]把他们射进宇宙深渊。[/b]

我们的角色当然丝毫不会因为夺走他人性命而遭受创伤。

也可以招募船员，但指挥一个角色就已经够笨拙了，而更大的船员队伍非常昂贵——无论是游戏里的钱，还是你的电脑。

[hr][/hr]

[h2]性能[/h2]

[b]我的天。[/b]

这游戏是单线程运行的吗，还是怎么回事？

假设你停靠在一艘中等大小的残骸上。首先你下令让你的小人拆掉20面墙和地板。你开启x16速度。有时会卡一下，但勉强还能进行。

然后你下令在自己的飞船上建造一个新房间。你铺开地板网格，在四周竖起墙壁。

[b]然后就完了。[/b]

我不知道物品运送逻辑是否检查了你飞船和残骸的每一个格子，但墙壁有时慢得不真实。如果你想铺20块地板，看起来就像所有格子都被检查了20遍，而当游戏终于把所有东西处理完时，突然就OK了。

而我们说的
这里说的是4×5的房间。如果有人想建造一个20×10的房间，会发生什么？

再加上漫长的加载时间和愚蠢的AI。你需要五个相同的物品？角色宁愿跑五趟单独的来回，也不愿一次拿起整叠五个。

[hr][/hr]

[h2]世界[/h2]

不幸的是，这个世界也非常空旷，给人一种模型布景的感觉。

在空间站里，你永远是唯一停靠的飞船。你永远不会看到NPC飞来、停靠或飞走。如果你靠近一个NPC已经停靠的残骸，那个NPC确实会在那里——但什么也不做。

所以你可以直接洗劫残骸，而它甚至不会注意到你。

更妙的是，当你飞到海盗的地盘，拆下对那里反应堆至关重要的组件时。没有人会做出反应。你可以直接把它搬上自己的飞船然后飞走。

这一切让这个世界看起来更像是一堆专门为玩家准备的场景集合，而不是一个真正有事情发生的活生生的地方。

[hr][/hr]

[h2]尽管如此……我还是推荐[/h2]

[i]Ostranauts[/i]有[b]非常多的不足之处[/b]。尽管有这么多批评，[b]我还是推荐这款游戏[/b]。

我还没有看完游戏的全部内容——我还没到行星探索、小行星采矿或终局部分，所以我不会假装自己在评价整体。

在我投入的[b]41个小时[/b]里，我真的非常投入。这里有很多事情可做，光是建造、升级和折腾飞船就能带来极大的满足感。

不过我认为，目前的完成度更像是一个[b]非常优秀的抢先体验版，而不是最终成品[/b]。

我会再给这款游戏一到两年的开发时间。我会关注新闻，等待大型更新。

[b]目前来说：推荐，但有保留意见。[/b]

observations.description: 游戏世界空洞，像静态模型，NPC不活跃
observations.evidence: Niestety świat jest również bardzo pusty i sprawia wrażenie makiety.
observations.evidence_zh: 遗憾的是，这个世界也非常空旷，给人一种模型布景的感觉。

items.text:
why is this game even fully released?

i spent like first 200hrs of my entire playtime on waiting for stutterings, guessing if this is bug or not and screaming at the monitor like a mad man. 
this game doesnt even have good content or ai system. no career options, no social system, no real consequences for crimes, and combat is too easy. and most of the skills in the games r not even implemented yet so there is no reason to choose them in character creation. every new game is the same and actually, the only reason u have to make a new game is because the incompetence of developers who keep updating the game every week and it causes the save file more problems and mod community tired.

the game advertises hiring crew and using gun is a fun thing to do. sounds fantastic? u can have ur own private army, pirate ship or mercenaries. and there r npcs with gun skills and u can start with gun skill actually.
however, these gun skills r not even implemented in the game. and they r not even acquirable during the game. weird right? if u shoot a lot enough, u should be able to hit something at some point. but player keep shooting themselves even with the gun skill. also most of the pirates carry empty hand guns and npcs do not carry rifles even tho guns r really cheap and they sell them in bulk in space station.

i asked the developer directly, why r u guys not fixing these gun skill problems? and he said, combat is not our priority. huh? so they r admitting they just false advertised one of the core game mechanicism?

also even after the full release, crew had ai problem that they just didnt work properly. so most of the players just didnt hire anyone and played the game without the feature. so i would call this game just a slop and a scam. considering that this game has been in a development for like idk a decade? and most of the space stations in the game arent even connected to other stations even tho they have subways? 

lack of content, false advertisement, repetitive gameplay and just insult to a gaming community for fully releasing the game
items.text_zh:
这游戏到底凭什么算正式发布了？

我整个游戏时间的前200小时左右，都花在等待卡顿、猜测这是不是bug，以及像个疯子一样对着显示器尖叫上。
这游戏甚至没有好的内容或AI系统。没有职业选择，没有社交系统，犯罪没有真正的后果，战斗也太简单了。而且游戏里大多数技能甚至都还没实装，所以角色创建时根本没有理由去选它们。每一局新游戏都一样，实际上，你之所以要开新档，唯一原因就是开发者无能，他们每周都在更新游戏，结果给存档文件带来更多问题，还让mod社区疲惫不堪。

游戏宣传说雇佣船员和使用枪械是件有趣的事。听起来很棒吧？你可以拥有自己的私人军队、海盗船或雇佣兵。而且还有具备枪械技能的NPC，你实际上也可以以枪械技能开局。
然而，这些枪械技能甚至都没在游戏里实装。而且它们在游戏过程中也无法获得。很奇怪吧？如果你开枪开得足够多，总该在某个时候能打中点什么吧。但玩家即使有枪械技能也还是会打到自己。此外，大多数海盗都带着空的手枪，NPC也不携带步枪，尽管枪械真的很便宜，而且空间站里还成批出售。

我直接问过开发者，你们为什么不修复这些枪械技能问题？他说，战斗不是我们的优先事项。哈？所以他们是在承认，他们只是虚假宣传了游戏的核心机制之一？

而且即使在正式发布之后，船员仍有AI问题，他们就是不能正常工作。所以大多数玩家干脆谁也不雇，在没有这个功能的情况下玩游戏。所以我会把这游戏称为一坨烂货和一场骗局。考虑到这游戏已经开发了大概，我也不知道，十年？而且游戏里大多数空间站甚至都没有和其他空间站连接起来，尽管它们有地铁？

内容匮乏、虚假宣传、玩法重复，简直就是对游戏社区的侮辱，居然还正式发布了这游戏

items.text:
[h2]A great core idea but with an underbaked release[/h2]

I've had my eye on this game for a long time, deliberately holding off until it was finished. So I was thrilled to see it hit 1.0 a few days ago, and with a sale on top of that I bought it immediately. The recent mixed reviews gave me pause, but I didn't pay them much attention because I wanted to finally experience the game for myself. In hindsight I probably should have listened, because I now find myself agreeing with the consensus: this is a very underbaked 1.0.

And I don't just mean bugs, of which there are many. You can tell while playing that a lot of features were built to about 20% and then left there.

Space navigation. It's genuinely very well done and enjoyable, and it's the one part of this game I have nothing bad to say about.

One example that stands in for a dozen: I have a zone full of building materials, a cart in my hands, and a blueprint waiting to be filled, and my character will deliver the materials [b]one at a time[/b], despite correctly using the cart when I explicitly tell him to haul. These systems are just plainly unfinished.

My read is that the devs got overly ambitious and tried to implement a lot of different things at once instead of going vertical and polishing each set of features before moving on, until they hit some kind of wall (money ran out, publisher pressure, burnout after years on the same project, who knows) and ultimately labeled this a finished product.

The NPC system exemplifies this. Hiring crew, but also just talking to station NPCs to handle mood requirements: something I thought was really cool for the first two minutes and that turned out so bad I wish it simply wasn't in the game. Contrast this with something like Project Zomboid, where the devs pulled NPCs entirely because they weren't satisfied with the implementation, and shipped narrow but fully polished slices with each release instead. That's the discipline this game needed, rather than forcing a broken system in.

[h3]Where that leaves me[/h3]
Exactly where I was trying not to be by waiting for 1.0: enamored with the premise and creative direction, but frustrated enough with the state of the game that I can't enjoy it without getting mad at some system not working properly every five minutes.

The devs have promised at least another year of development, and I hope that means more than a few bugfixes, because several systems urgently need more love and attention. As things stand I can't recommend it to new players, partly so nobody else walks into what I walked into. Wait 6 to 12 months and see where the progress is by then, because whatever labels are used, [b]this game is still in an EA state[/b].

[hr][/hr]

[h3]Software engineering side note[/h3]
I've read the dev's post about not wanting to use generative AI for coding tasks, and everyone is free to work how they please, but as a software engineer I think it's a self-inflicted wound. Getting half-finished features across the line is exactly where these tools are strongest. Hardcoded text strings apparently blocking localization is a couple of days of work at most with an assistant scanning the codebase for them.
items.text_zh:
[h2]一个很棒的核心创意，但发布版本火候未到[/h2]

我关注这款游戏已经很久了，一直刻意等到它完成才入手。所以几天前看到它发布1.0版本时我非常激动，再加上还有打折，我立刻就买了下来。最近的褒贬不一评价让我犹豫了一下，但我没太在意，因为我想终于亲自体验一下这款游戏。事后看来，我大概应该听进去的，因为我现在发现自己同意主流看法：这是一个非常半生不熟的1.0版本。

而且我说的不只是bug，虽然bug确实很多。玩的时候你就能看出来，很多功能只做到了大约20%就被搁置了。

太空导航。这部分确实做得非常好，也很有趣，是这款游戏里我唯一挑不出毛病的地方。

举一个能代表十几个问题的例子：我有一个堆满建筑材料的区域，手里有一辆推车，还有一个等着被填充的蓝图，而我的角色会[b]一次一件地[/b]运送材料，尽管当我明确告诉他要搬运时，他确实会正确使用推车。这些系统显然就是没做完。

我的理解是，开发者过于雄心勃勃，试图一次性实现很多不同的东西，而不是纵向深入、在继续前进之前把每一组功能打磨好，直到他们撞上了某种墙（钱花完了、发行商施压、在同一个项目上做了多年后倦怠了，谁知道呢），最终把这个标成了完成品。

NPC系统就是典型例子。雇佣船员，以及仅仅为了处理心情需求而和空间站NPC交谈：这东西我头两分钟还觉得真的很酷，结果差到我希望它干脆别出现在游戏里。对比一下《僵尸毁灭工程》这样的作品，那边的开发者因为对NPC实现不满意而把NPC整个撤掉了，每次发布都只推出范围狭窄但完全打磨好的部分。这才是这款游戏需要的自律，而不是硬塞进一个坏掉的系统。

[h3]这让我处于什么境地[/h3]
正是我当初等到1.0就是想避免的境地：被它的前提和创作方向迷住了，但对游戏的状态沮丧到无法享受它，因为每五分钟就会因为某个系统不能正常工作而生气。

开发者承诺至少还会再开发一年，我希望这不只是修几个bug，因为有好几个系统迫切需要更多关爱和关注。就目前情况而言，我无法向新玩家推荐它，部分原因也是不想让别人再走进我走进的这个坑。等6到12个月，看看那时进展如何，因为不管用什么标签，[b]这款游戏仍然处于EA状态[/b]。

[hr][/hr]

[h3]软件工程方面的附注[/h3]
我读过开发者关于不想在编码任务中使用生成式AI的帖子，每个人都有按自己意愿工作的自由，但作为一名软件工程师，我认为这是自找麻烦。把半成品功能推过终点线，恰恰是这些工具最擅长的地方。据说阻碍本地化的硬编码文本字符串，在助手的帮助下扫描代码库找出它们，最多也就几天的工作量。

items.text:
I just can't recommend getting it as is i am afraid. 

- The character creation sucks and is lacking features like presets and preset saving, which is not that major anyways, since there is one player model and no matter what it won't look anything like your character regardless of what you chose. It's not just a visual element, i just also dislike the element of randomness in a character creation.

- The UI is awful. In fact, i think this has got to be bar none the worst UI i've ever had to deal with in a video game and i've known the dos era. The information is disorganized, badly presented, implies insane amounts of clicking, the (too) many UI elements have little graphic/logical coherency, it's just a terrible, terrible time dealing with it all. Sure you *can* get used to it. But it was just bad design that stuck throughout EA when it should have been scrapped and redone. No UI/UX person on board and it really shows sadly. Whether it be inventory, character information, terrain or anything else, you'll be trying to enjoy yourself in spite of it the whole time. 

- The game's whole premise is to foster a "theatre of the mind" (dev's words, not mine), but the entire NPC interaction system is just terrible. It's essentially the sims type of interactions, with no logic or coherency in interactions. It all boils down just standing like a chimp in front of NPCs you wish to engage with and spamming dialogue options until you get high enough relations that they decide to acknowledge your existence and give you what you expect from them. At no point this system even attempts to make sense and you find yourself chaining nonsensical interactions. It is *so bad*.

- The graphical fidelity still gets in the way of readability on many objects and terrain. Beyond the aesthetic choice, it's just so low fidelity that one struggles to just make sense of what's on screen most of the time, and while in many games this sort of aesthetic can look pleasing when done right, this just looks unreadable, visually busy and unappealing.

- The performance, which was a big problem when i first picked the game up during EA, has been improved, although i'm still experiencing memory leaks and major slowdowns with very little on the screen = Automatic negative review. Those leaks were identified over a year ago, there was ample time to fix them.

- Feature wise it's rather rich in my opinion but content wise it's still rather devoid of content and sadly my understanding is that the dev simply had to push it out the door for lack of funds. In this game you'll find very little story-driven elements and hand-crafted narratives. What's there is good, but it's insufficient. For a sandbox game like this one, it feels very empty.

- The soundscape is still very bland, which for a game purporting to immerse you, is a big let-down.

- The game pushes you to hire a crew but the whole crew management/interaction gameplay (and especially performance, yikes) feels very janky. 

- Outside of the few handcrafted quests, the rest is typical sandbox busy work nonsense fluff and fetch-quests. Yawn.

- Jobs (non handcrafted quests) tend to be buggy and break, leading players to decide to just skip this entire area and to focus on other revenue streams.

So what's there to enjoy then?

- The ship piloting feels excellent.
- The scavenging, albeit repetitive as sin over time, is interesting.
- Ship building is interesting to engage with and has plenty of features to deal with.
- Exploring, although limited because again, world feels bland, empty and unfinished.
- There's some measure of hope for this game as it features a steam workshop integration.
- Murder investigations, if they weren't still as buggy, would be enjoyable as well.

My hope for the game is that the dev keeps working on it to finish what was clearly not yet cooked and ready to come out of the oven. On top of that, i hope for modders to address the main issues of this game, first and foremost the unforgivably bad NPC interaction system, and if at all possible, the UI.

As it stands though, do yourself a favor and do not engage until significant work is done on this title. It's a big let down for me and i'm sorry about it because i have a lot of respect for the Dev as a person, but this soured me on supporting their future endeavors a great deal.
items.text_zh:
恐怕我只能说，就目前这个样子，我实在没法推荐购买。

- 角色创建很糟糕，缺少预设和预设保存之类的功能，不过反正这也没那么重要，因为只有一个玩家模型，不管你选了什么，它看起来都完全不像你的角色。这不仅仅是个视觉元素的问题，我也很讨厌角色创建里的随机性元素。

- UI 糟透了。事实上，我觉得这绝对是我在电子游戏里遇到过的最烂的 UI，我可是经历过 DOS 时代的人。信息杂乱无章，呈现得很差，意味着要疯狂点击，那些（过多的）UI 元素在图形/逻辑上几乎没有连贯性，处理这一切简直就是一段糟糕透顶、糟糕透顶的体验。当然，你*可以*习惯它。但这本身就是糟糕的设计，在整个 EA 阶段一直存在，本该被废弃重做。团队里没有 UI/UX 方面的人，这一点很遗憾地暴露无遗。无论是物品栏、角色信息、地形还是别的什么，你全程都得在忍受它的同时努力让自己玩得开心。

- 这游戏的整个前提是营造一种“心灵剧场”（这是开发者的话，不是我说的），但整个 NPC 交互系统就是糟糕透顶。它本质上是《模拟人生》那种交互，交互中毫无逻辑或连贯性。一切都归结为像只黑猩猩一样站在你想互动的 NPC 面前，狂刷对话选项，直到关系值够高，他们才决定承认你的存在，给你你期望从他们那里得到的东西。这个系统在任何时候都甚至没有尝试过要讲得通，你会发现自己在一连串毫无意义的交互中循环。它*太糟了*。

- 图形保真度仍然妨碍着许多物体和地形的可读性。抛开审美选择不谈，它的保真度就是太低了，大多数时候人都很难看懂屏幕上是什么，虽然在很多游戏里这种审美如果做得好会看起来令人愉悦，但这个看起来就是难以辨认、视觉上杂乱且毫无吸引力。

- 性能问题，在我最初于 EA 阶段入手这游戏时是个大问题，现在已经有所改善，不过我仍然会遇到内存泄漏和严重的卡顿，而屏幕上几乎没什么东西 = 自动差评。那些泄漏一年多以前就被发现了，有充足的时间去修复。

- 就功能而言，在我看来相当丰富，但就内容而言，它仍然相当缺乏内容，而且遗憾的是，据我所知，开发者只是因为缺钱不得不把它赶着推出门。在这个游戏里，你会发现极少有剧情驱动的元素和手工打造的叙事。现有的内容是不错，但不够。对于像这样的沙盒游戏来说，它感觉非常空洞。

- 音景仍然非常平淡，对于一个号称要让你沉浸其中的游戏来说，这是很大的失望。

- 游戏推动你去雇佣一支船员，但整个船员管理/交互的玩法（尤其是性能，哎呀）感觉非常蹩脚。

- 除了少数几个手工打造的任务之外，其余都是典型的沙盒式忙碌工作、无意义的填充内容和跑腿任务。呵欠。

- 工作（非手工打造的任务）往往有 bug 并且会出故障，导致玩家决定干脆跳过这整个区域，转而专注于其他收入来源。

那么还有什么可享受的呢？

- 飞船驾驶手感极佳。
- 拾荒，尽管时间久了重复得要命，但挺有意思。
- 飞船建造玩起来很有意思，而且有大量功能可以折腾。
- 探索，尽管受限，因为还是那句话，世界感觉平淡、空洞且未完成。
- 这游戏还有一定希望，因为它集成了 Steam 创意工坊。
- 谋杀案调查，如果它们不是仍然那么多 bug 的话，也会挺有趣的。

我对这游戏的希望是开发者继续努力，把那些显然还没煮熟、还没准备好出炉的东西做完。除此之外，我希望模组作者能解决这游戏的主要问题，首当其冲的就是那不可原谅的糟糕 NPC 交互系统，如果可能的话，还有 UI。

不过就目前而言，行行好，在这个作品有重大改进之前别去碰它。这让我非常失望，我也为此感到遗憾，因为我个人非常尊重这位开发者，但这件事让我在支持他们未来事业方面大打了折扣。

items.text:
This is one of those really difficult reviews where I wish I could give a more nuanced rating than "yes" or "no", but I have to lean toward "no". While my hours are inflated (full hours get added up from if it was running when you enter/exit your computer's sleep mode), it's absolutely been something I'd come back to repeatedly, so if the question is "will you get ~$16  of entertainment?" the answer is very probably "Yes".

However, the game has MASSIVE flaws, and ultimately it hasn't changed much from the state it was in even like 4-5 years ago. 

I've seen a lot of reviews go into detail about issues with the AI, and while those can be real I think a lot of the discussion there is kinda missing the bigger picture:
[b]This game has no point.[/b]

Gameplay for you if you've started is gonna feel exciting! There's so many wrecks to go explore, if you have a keen eye you might notice a couple (as in just two...) nearby-ish areas worth checking out, and you'll probably find yourself in a pretty initially satisfying loop of scrapping ships for valuable components to sell and improving your own starter ship a little. 

Then you might start trying to flip ships to make some serious money sooner, or to at least be less dependent on OKLG since there's literally no sources of electrical power other than fusion reactors or buying it from a station.

Now the game will have started to feel a lot more grindy, especially as you start to realize how many systems just aren't deep at all... except maybe deeply repetitive. But alright, you're making money and maybe hired an NPC and you've been micromanaging twice as much as before because their autonomy sucks and the tools to give them specific orders suck (you can't even queue orders except in a very specific way that has no priority or order and might result in them deciding it's time to nearly smoke themselves to death in airlock instead of working). 

But hey, now you've got the cash to pay off your debt and afford fuel for the fusion reactor you've built by now! It's time to go torching across the system! And hey, there seemed to at least be one quest that had actual story to it instead of being FO4 infinite quest tier, over at The Flotilla, maybe the world's gonna finally open up now and have so much more depth!

Oh.

[i] Oh... [/i]

It's about here where, after journeying for a few days to Venus or Ceres, that feeling is going to start to creep in. You'll realize almost nothing is really different -- that every station feels exceptionally sterile and lifeless, and while there's a few tiny scattered bits of content you can try to participate in, there's somehow even less story content there to capture you than NEO Scavenger. 

Anyway, that probably does an adequate job of describing my main gripe with the game. 

Because, see, It runs well, it's truly cool how some systems can appear to have depth at first, and while there's massive issues with AI you don't really have to engage with them at all. Even with flaws like the AI, you can make some use of a crewmember by just keeping them on permanent repair duty inside the ship or just treat them as an organic sex doll + chatbot combo to keep your captain's moods up. Not that the moods really matter almost at all. 

Well, I guess even when saying it's cool, I can't avoid discussing flaws, huh! Same as I could discuss how cool the travel is... until you try docking at venus and realize the values you're provided are super wonky and there's very little in the way of orbital info provided to you, making docking a continuous-thrust sort of affair that somehow just feels deeply *wrong* speaking as a long-time player of games like KSP, COADE, Orbiter, etc.

Aaaaand then it always comes back to that sterility I mentioned. Every station feels empty and lifeless or just populated by ants, 99% of the apparent quests are totally sterile and literally lacking even distinct flavor text while the remainder aren't nearly common or deep enough and feel totally detached from all the systems you've otherwise been engaging with, and even the few legitimate additions compared to a few years ago like ship combat are just so simplistic and easy and hardly feel satisfying since they really don't feel meaningful on much of a level and tend to just make you realize that even on a systems level this is a game that might have 2 or 3 parts for something where another game might have 10 or 20+. 

Maybe some day Modders Will Fix It (tm), but I really don't think that seems likely. It's a great concept, but the execution is deeply lacking and frankly kinda lazy given the dev-time. If Dan ever reads this, I really don't wanna crush your spirits man, there's a reason I've still played the game probably something like 60-80 hours as of the time of the review, but this just feels like a game that could have been done significantly better instead of basically being released at a state that really feels like an Alpha or Beta build deeply in need of more content and depth. 




btw since some people have complained about performance, check my attached specs, my hardware absolutely isn't supercomputer tier and it runs just as well even on my thinkpad, I DO think the dev's done a pretty nice job on optimization.
items.text_zh:
这是一篇非常难写的评测，我希望能给出比“是”或“否”更细致的评分，但我不得不倾向于“否”。虽然我的游戏时长被夸大了（如果你在电脑进入/退出睡眠模式时游戏仍在运行，完整的小时数也会被累加进去），但这绝对是我会反复回来玩的东西，所以如果问题是“你能从中获得大约16美元的娱乐价值吗？”答案很可能是“能”。

然而，这款游戏有着巨大的缺陷，而且归根结底，它和四五年前的状态相比几乎没什么变化。

我看到很多评测详细讨论了AI的问题，虽然那些问题确实存在，但我认为很多相关讨论有点没抓住重点：
[b]这款游戏没有意义。[/b]

如果你刚开始玩，游戏体验会让你感到兴奋！有那么多残骸可以去探索，如果你眼尖的话，可能会注意到附近有那么几个（也就是仅仅两个……）值得一看的区域，而且你可能会发现自己陷入一个最初相当令人满足的循环：拆解飞船获取有价值的部件来出售，并稍微升级你自己的初始飞船。

然后你可能会开始尝试倒卖飞船来更快地赚大钱，或者至少减少对OKLG的依赖，因为除了聚变反应堆或从空间站购买之外， literally 没有任何电力来源。

现在游戏会开始感觉更加肝了，尤其是当你开始意识到有多少系统根本毫无深度……也许只是深度重复。但好吧，你在赚钱，也许雇了一个NPC，而且你一直在做双倍的微观管理，因为他们的自主性很糟糕，而且给他们下达具体命令的工具也很糟糕（你甚至无法排队命令，除非用一种非常特定的方式，这种方式没有优先级也没有顺序，可能导致他们决定是时候在气闸里把自己差点熏死，而不是去工作）。

但是嘿，现在你有现金来还清债务，并为你现在已经建好的聚变反应堆买得起燃料了！是时候穿越整个星系了！而且嘿，在The Flotilla那里似乎至少有一个任务有真正的剧情，而不是FO4那种无限任务级别的东西，也许世界终于要开放了，会有更多的深度！

哦。

[i] 哦…… [/i]

大约就是在这里，在前往金星或谷神星旅行了几天之后，那种感觉会开始悄悄袭来。你会意识到几乎没有什么真正不同——每个空间站都感觉异常 sterile 和毫无生气，虽然有一些零星的微小内容可以尝试参与，但那里能吸引你的剧情内容不知怎的比NEO Scavenger还要少。

总之，这大概足够描述我对这款游戏的主要不满之处了。

因为，你看，它运行良好，有些系统一开始看起来有深度，这真的很酷，而且虽然AI有巨大的问题，但你其实完全不必去碰它们。即使有AI这样的缺陷，你也可以通过让船员在飞船内永久执行维修任务来利用他们，或者干脆把他们当作有机性爱娃娃+聊天机器人的组合来保持船长的情绪。倒不是说情绪几乎完全不重要。

好吧，我想即使是在说它酷的时候，我也无法避免讨论缺陷，是吧！就像我可以讨论旅行有多酷……直到你尝试在金星对接，然后意识到提供给你的数值超级不稳定，而且几乎没有提供任何轨道信息，使得对接变成一种持续推力式的操作，作为一个长期玩KSP、COADE、Orbiter等游戏的玩家来说，这不知怎的就让人感觉深深*不对劲*。

然后一切又总是回到我提到的那种 sterile 感。每个空间站都感觉空荡荡、毫无生气，或者只是挤满了蚂蚁，99%的表面任务都完全 sterile，甚至字面上缺乏独特的风味文本，而剩下的那些又不够常见或不够有深度，感觉与你一直在互动的所有系统完全脱节，即使是相比几年前少数几个真正的添加内容，比如飞船战斗，也太过简单和容易，几乎不让人觉得满足，因为它们真的在大多数层面上感觉没什么意义，而且往往只会让你意识到，即使在系统层面上，这也是一款可能只有两三个部分的游戏，而另一款游戏可能有10个或20个以上。

也许有一天Modders Will Fix It（tm），但我真的不认为那看起来有可能。这是一个很棒的概念，但执行深度不足，坦率地说，考虑到开发时间，有点懒惰。如果Dan读到这个，我真的不想打击你的士气，老兄，我在写这篇评测时仍然玩了大概60到80个小时是有原因的，但这感觉就像是一款本可以做得明显更好的游戏，而不是基本上以一个真的感觉像是Alpha或Beta版本的状态发布，急需更多内容和深度。




顺便说一句，既然有些人抱怨性能问题，看看我附上的配置，我的硬件绝对不是超级计算机级别的，即使在我的ThinkPad上运行得也一样好，我确实认为开发者在优化方面做得相当不错。
在提供给你的轨道信息方面，对接变成了一种持续推力式的操作，作为一个长期玩KSP、COADE、Orbiter等游戏的玩家来说，这种感觉莫名地就是深深*不对劲*。

然后，一切又总是回到我提到的那种死气沉沉。每个空间站都感觉空荡荡、毫无生气，或者只是被一群蚂蚁占据着，99%的表面任务都完全死板，甚至字面上连独特的风味文本都没有，而剩下的那些又不够常见或不够深入，感觉与你本来一直在互动的所有系统完全脱节，即使是相比几年前少数几个真正的添加内容，比如舰船战斗，也太过简单、太容易，几乎感觉不到满足感，因为它们真的在大多数层面上感觉不到有意义，而且往往只会让你意识到，即使在系统层面上，这也是一个可能只有2到3个部分的东西，而另一个游戏可能会有10个或20多个。

也许有一天Modders Will Fix It (tm)，但我真的不认为那看起来可能。这是一个很棒的概念，但执行上严重不足，坦率地说，考虑到开发时间，还有点懒。如果Dan读到这个，我真的不想打击你的士气，老兄，有一个原因是我在写这篇评测时可能已经玩了大概60-80小时，但这感觉就像是一个本可以做得明显更好的游戏，而不是基本上以一个真的感觉像是Alpha或Beta版本的状态发布，急需更多内容和深度。




顺便说一句，既然有些人抱怨性能问题，看看我附上的配置，我的硬件绝对不是超级计算机级别的，即使在我的ThinkPad上运行得也一样好，我确实认为开发者在优化方面做得相当不错。

items.text:
Sadly not the game I was hopping for:

It's just a bunch of unrelated features thrown into a mix with a bad 2D space engineer rip-off.
Systems such as NPC interactions are completely meaningless and boring. 
The game is not challenging at all.

And you'll never be sure whether it's a bug or just not programmed into the game.
On one occasion, I had two NPCs die at the K-Log port in front of a kiosk. None of the other NPCs reacted to it, and the bodies were still there hours later.

Another example of this abysmal game design:
I boarded a neutral ship above K-Log, and the game indicated that this was a hostile act with consequences. However, neither the pilot nor anyone on K-Log recognised this. 

Even after killing the pilot and selling some of his ship parts at the port, nothing happened.

It feels like different mechanics have been thrown together without any real purpose.

像NPC互动这样的系统完全毫无意义且无聊。
这游戏根本没有任何挑战性。

而且你永远无法确定某个东西是bug还是根本没被编程进游戏里。
有一次，我在K-Log港的一个售货亭前有两个NPC死了。其他NPC都没有对此做出反应，几个小时后尸体还在那里。

另一个这种糟糕游戏设计的例子：
我在K-Log上方登上了一艘中立飞船，游戏提示这是一种敌对行为并会有后果。然而，无论是飞行员还是K-Log上的任何人都没有意识到这一点。

即使在杀死飞行员并在港口卖掉他的一些飞船部件之后，什么也没有发生。

感觉就像不同的机制被胡乱拼凑在一起，没有任何真正的目的。
